items.title: 3.8.3 Average Value of a Function (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 119-120: 3.8.3 definition box (average value), Example 70 and Example 71 (temperature sensor).

blocks.text: Average to aap bachpan se nikal rahe hain: paanch tests ke marks jama karo aur 5 se divide karo. Lekin agar koi cheez har lamhe badal rahi ho, jaise din bhar ka temperature ya chalti gaari ki speed, to us ki "readings" gin nahin sakte, woh beshumar hain. Aisi soorat mein jama (sum) ki jagah integral aur ginti (count) ki jagah interval ki lambai aa jati hai. Yahi is sabaq ka poora khayal hai.

blocks.title: Definition
blocks.text: Agar \(f\) interval \([a, b]\) par continuous ho, to \([a, b]\) par us ki average value (jise mean value bhi kehte hain) yeh hai: \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is box ka heading kat kar "finition:" chhapa hai; asal mein yeh "Definition:" hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh formula kyun? \(n\) numbers ka average = (un ka jama) \(\div n\). Continuous function ki \([a, b]\) par beshumar values hoti hain, is liye jama ki jagah integral \(\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\) aur \(n\) ki jagah interval ki lambai \(b - a\) aa jati hai.
Tasveer mein samjhiye: \(f_{\text{av}}\) us rectangle ki unchai hai jo \([a, b]\) par bana ho aur jis ka area curve ke neeche wale area ke barabar ho: \((b - a)\,f_{\text{av}} = \int_a^b f(x)\,dx\). Jaise ret ke dher ko hamwar (level) kar dein to jo unchai banti hai, wahi average hai: unche hisse neeche wale garhon ko bhar dete hain.
Kaam ki shakal: \(\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = (b - a)\,f_{\text{av}}\). Exercise 3.7 ke sawal 8 se 11 isi par chalte hain, is liye ise achhi tarah yaad kar lijiye.
Ab kitab ki pehli misaal. Is mein interval ka lower limit negative hai, is liye signs par khaas nazar rakhiye.

blocks.title: Example 70
blocks.problem: Find the average value of the function \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2\) over the interval \([-1, 2]\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2\), interval \([-1, 2]\).
Maloom karna: average value \(f_{\text{av}}\).
Tareeqa: definition \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\) mein \(a = -1\), \(b = 2\) rakhenge. \(f\) polynomial hai, is liye continuous hai aur definition lag sakti hai.

Formula likhein
\(a = -1\) aur \(b = 2\) ke saath:
\[f_{\text{av}} = \dfrac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2-(-1)}\int_{-1}^{2}(x^{2} + 2)\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}\left[\dfrac{x^{3}}{3} + 2x\right]_{-1}^{2}\]
Kyun: \(b - a = 2 - (-1) = 3\) (minus minus plus). \(x^{2} + 2\) ka antiderivative \(\frac{x^{3}}{3} + 2x\) hai, power rule se.

Limits lagayein
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}\left[\left(\dfrac{2^{3}}{3} + 2(2)\right) - \left(\dfrac{(-1)^{3}}{3} + 2(-1)\right)\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}\left(\dfrac{8}{3} + \dfrac{1}{3} + 4 + 2\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}\left(\dfrac{9}{3} + 6\right) = 3\]
Kyun: \((-1)^{3} = -1\), is liye lower limit par value \(-\frac{1}{3} - 2\) hai; ise minus karne se \(+\frac{1}{3} + 2\) ban jata hai.
Dhyan dein: yahi jagah hai jahan sab se zyada sign ki ghaltiyan hoti hain; bracket laga kar likhiye.

Tasdeeq:
\([-1, 2]\) par \(f\) ki sab se chhoti value \(f(0) = 2\) aur sab se bari \(f(2) = 6\) hai; average 3 in dono ke darmiyan hai, jaisa hona chahiye. Aur \(x = 1\) par \(f(1) = 3\), yani function waqai kahin apni average value leta hai.
blocks.answer: \([-1, 2]\) par \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2\) ki average value 3 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki pehli line \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{2-(-1)}\int_{-1}^{2}(x^{2}+2)\,dx\) chhapti hai, yani beech mein \(f_{\text{av}}\) dobara aa gaya hai. Sahi likhai: \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = \frac{1}{2-(-1)}\int_{-1}^{2}(x^{2}+2)\,dx\). Jawab 3 bilkul sahi hai.
Doosri misaal asal zindagi ki hai: ek sensor patri (track) par chalte hue temperature naapta hai. Yahan variable \(x\) waqt nahin balke jagah (position) hai, lekin average ka formula wahi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Example 71
blocks.problem: A temperature sensor moves slowly along a 10-meter track, continuously measuring temperature. The temperature at position \(x\) is given by \(T(x) = 20 + x\), where \(T(x)\) is in \(^{\circ}\)C. Find the average temperature measured by the sensor as it moves from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 10\) meters.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(T(x) = 20 + x\) \(^{\circ}\)C, jab \(0 \le x \le 10\) m.
Maloom karna: average temperature.
Tareeqa: kisi lagataar badalti miqdaar ki interval par average \(\frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b T(x)\,dx\) hai; yahan \(a = 0\), \(b = 10\).

Average likhein
Function: \(T(x) = 20 + x\); limits \(x = 0\) se \(x = 10\) tak.
\[\text{Average Temperature} = \dfrac{1}{10 - 0}\int_{0}^{10}(20 + x)\,dx\]
Kyun: sensor har jagah lagataar naap raha hai, is liye chand readings jama karne ki bajaye integral se average lete hain.

Integrate kar ke hisaab lagayein
\[= \dfrac{1}{10}\left[20x + \dfrac{x^{2}}{2}\right]_{0}^{10}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{10}\left[\left(20(10) + \dfrac{(10)^{2}}{2}\right) - \left(20(0) + \dfrac{(0)^{2}}{2}\right)\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{10}(200 + 50) = 25\,^{\circ}\text{C}\]
Kyun: \(\int 20\,dx = 20x\) aur \(\int x\,dx = \frac{x^{2}}{2}\). Lower limit 0 par sab zero hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(T\) seedhi line (linear) hai, is liye us ka average dono siron ki values ka average hai: \(\frac{T(0) + T(10)}{2} = \frac{20 + 30}{2} = 25\). Wahi jawab.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. \([0, 3]\) par \(f(x) = 2x\) ki average value?
\(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{3 - 0}\int_{0}^{3}2x\,dx = \frac{1}{3}[x^{2}]_{0}^{3} = \frac{9}{3} = 3\).
Tasdeeq: \(f\) linear hai, to average \(= \frac{f(0) + f(3)}{2} = \frac{0 + 6}{2} = 3\). Sahi!
Khud sochiye: \([0, 2]\) par \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ka average kya hoga? (Jawab: \(\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{8}{3} = \frac{4}{3}\); dhyan dein ke yeh \(\frac{0 + 4}{2} = 2\) nahin, kyun ke \(x^{2}\) linear nahin.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(f_{\text{av}} = \frac{1}{b-a}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\), jab \(f\) interval \([a, b]\) par continuous ho.
2. Doosri shakal: \(\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = (b - a)\,f_{\text{av}}\).
3. Average hamesha \(f\) ki sab se chhoti aur sab se bari value ke darmiyan hota hai.
4. Seedhi line (linear) function ke liye average = dono siron ki values ka average.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(b - a\) se divide karna bhool jana: akela integral area hai, average nahin.
2. \(b + a\) ya \(a - b\) le lena: \(a = -1\), \(b = 2\) ke liye lambai \(2 - (-1) = 3\) hai.
3. Negative lower limit par sign ki ghalti: \(\left(\frac{(-1)^{3}}{3} + 2(-1)\right) = -\frac{7}{3}\), aur ise minus karne se \(+\frac{7}{3}\) banta hai.
4. Har function ke liye "dono siron ka average" laga dena: yeh sirf linear function par sahi hai.
